indirect.users: SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM users u LEFT JOIN company_user cu ON cu.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN branch_user bu ON bu.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = bu.branch_id WHERE cu.company_id = {{ID}} OR b.company_id = {{ID}}
